info.text:
In Oct. 2025, a fake CEO livestream drew nearly 8x the real stream's viewers.

Oct. 28, 2025: a fake Jensen Huang stream had about 95,000 live viewers at one point vs about 12,000 on Nvidia's real stream (CRN), pushing a QR code to a site promising to double any crypto sent.
The FTC said people sent more than $2 million to Elon Musk impersonators in six months (Oct. 2020 to March 2021).
Crypto-related fraud losses reported to the FBI hit $11.4 billion in 2025, versus $9.3 billion in 2024.

Sources: CRN, Bitdefender (July 2024), FTC Data Spotlight (May 2021), FBI IC3 2024 and 2025 reports.
News and education, not financial advice.
